q1_issues.issue: (Most great sk_mystery_1 mystery) asserts this is THE greatest mystery, but "one of the greatest mysteries" explicitly declines that uniqueness claim.
"in all of science" is attached to the entity rather than bounding the superlative's comparison class, so the ranking reads as unrestricted and "all of" is dropped.

q2_gaps: "one of the ADJ-est Ns" (non-unique superlative) - Most encodes a unique maximum, Ordinal encodes a rank, and the partitive machinery offers no slot for a superlative-restricted superset
notes: Using In rather than LocatedIn for the domain PP is right per the framing/domain-PP rule. Identifying the antecedentless "this" with the mystery witness is a defensible reading of "the salient kind if the text supplies one".
